scope: Accepted 1856–1857 batch-32 source-text rendering, enclosure attribution, chronology, special-markup and provenance requirements only. Requirements documentation candidate; no converter, transcript, corpus, ledger, accepted-evidence or export changes.

requirements.case: 1817 authorial Notes for Mr Darwin enclosure and Crump gap
requirements.requirement: Treat the long Notes for Mr Darwin enclosure as an authorial Blyth enclosure preserved as a scholarly sibling under 1817, with its own enclosure DOM boundary and voice. Keep CD annotations, footnotes, bibliography and later Darwin marginal abstracts separate. The historical 1818 label must not duplicate this surviving enclosure. Crump-to-Blyth 1819 is a separate forwarded report whose authentic body is still under recovery; do not claim to have read it or use it as a Darwin prompt. Missing Darwin letters of 5 and 22 November and Moore query material remain missing.

scholarly_boundaries.attribution: Edward Blyth authorial enclosure; not CD annotation

exact_source_evidence.quote: I have two letters of yours to answer, respectively dated Novr. 5th & 22nd
Different species of Treron seem to interbreed, & ditto Coracias; but not Treron with Coracias!
Coracias, 3 Indian species,—garrula in the N.W. only,— indica throughout India, replaced E. of the Bay by affinis.
